t200-lg-e1.label: Share of IPL innings reaching 200, 2008–2023
t200-lg-e1.dataset: CricField warehouse: Cricsheet IPL ball-by-ball data, 2008–2026
t200-lg-e1.query: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) < 2024 AND i.runs >= 200 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) < 2024 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) e1, SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) >= 2024 AND i.runs >= 200 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) >= 2024 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) e2, COUNT(*) n FROM innings i JOIN matches m ON m.match_id = i.match_id WHERE i.innings_number <= 2

t200-all.label: GT totals of 200 or more
t200-all.dataset: CricField warehouse: Cricsheet IPL ball-by-ball data, 2008–2026
t200-all.query: SELECT CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) year, SUM(CASE WHEN i.batting_team_id IN (14) AND i.runs >= 200 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) t200, SUM(CASE WHEN i.batting_team_id IN (14) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) tn, SUM(CASE WHEN i.runs >= 200 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) lshare FROM innings i JOIN matches m ON m.match_id = i.match_id WHERE i.innings_number <= 2 GROUP BY year ORDER BY year

t200-lgwin.label: IPL win rate when posting 200 or more batting first
t200-lgwin.dataset: CricField warehouse: Cricsheet IPL ball-by-ball data, 2008–2026
t200-lgwin.query: SELECT COUNT(*) n, SUM(CASE WHEN m.winner_id = i.batting_team_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) won FROM innings i JOIN matches m ON m.match_id = i.match_id WHERE i.innings_number = 1 AND i.runs >= 200 AND m.winner_id IS NOT NULL

t200-twin.label: GT win rate when posting 200 or more batting first
t200-twin.dataset: CricField warehouse: Cricsheet IPL ball-by-ball data, 2008–2026
t200-twin.query: SELECT CASE WHEN m.venue_id IN (SELECT venue_id FROM venues WHERE name LIKE '%Narendra Modi%' OR name LIKE '%Motera%') THEN 'home' ELSE 'away' END loc, COUNT(*) n, SUM(CASE WHEN m.winner_id = i.batting_team_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) won FROM innings i JOIN matches m ON m.match_id = i.match_id WHERE i.innings_number = 1 AND i.runs >= 200 AND i.batting_team_id IN (14) AND m.winner_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY loc
